words: Eye pass 5 failed its gate (A and B below pass 2 in face-on run 1; D last in side run 2 and below pass 2 in face-on run 1). As declared before the pass, the pass 2 eye ships in the slice and there is no pass 6. D-2nx5 stays open and goes to Nick as one question with pictures (stall rule). The builder's view-space trace corrects the audit N-g6rs cause: the lids already cut 15 to 19 percent top and 9 to 11 percent bottom; the gap is width, the iris spans the opening corner to corner so no iris arc shows at either side. Production answer: the eye is authored to a measured eye spec at the sheet stage (opening wider than the iris with eyeball visible at both corners, a crisp catchlight, no pale lower wet line), not tuned after the sculpt. Kept 283.30 px/m for the sprites: the rest body now measures 191.0 px only because the sunk pad sole was removed, so the on-screen size matches pass 4; overridable.
